$comment: Derived from teletemagame-dev/minecraft-for-astra@v0.3.1. Digests are of the bytes the bot downloaded and the attestation covers. Ownership proved by: well-known.

fire_trigger.reason: Lets your commands react to what happens in the game: chat, damage, low health, death

send_chat_message.reason: Lets players talk to Astra in Minecraft chat and hear her answer there

set_variable.reason: Publishes the bot's position, health and food so commands can read them without a tool call
